ads-and-tracking.title: Ads & Tracking
ads-and-tracking.description: Balanced ad and tracker blocking with few false positives. Good default for most homes.

ads-and-tracking-extended.title: Ads & Tracking (Extended)
ads-and-tracking-extended.description: Aggressive ad, tracker, telemetry and pop-up blocking. Blocks more, may need occasional allowlisting.

mobile-ads.title: Mobile Ads
mobile-ads.description: Ad networks used inside Android and iOS apps.

mobile-spyware.title: Mobile Spyware & Telemetry
mobile-spyware.description: Phone-maker and app telemetry/tracking (Apple, Samsung, Xiaomi, Huawei, Oppo/Realme, Vivo, TikTok) plus Android trackers.

youtube-ads.title: YouTube Ads
youtube-ads.description: Google/YouTube ad-serving domains. Blocks some YouTube ads (mostly on websites, apps and smart TVs); DNS cannot block all YouTube video ads.

smart-tv.title: Smart TV & Streaming Devices
smart-tv.description: Tracking and ads on smart TVs and streaming sticks (Samsung, LG webOS, Roku, Amazon Fire).

security.title: Security (Malware, Phishing, Scams)
security.description: Malware, phishing, scam and fake-shop domains from threat-intelligence feeds.
